body.statement: For the theorem-level comparison, \(\mathfrak C_{\mathrm H}\) is the class of two-wave policy-design problems with a continuously parameterized action \(\gamma\in\Gamma_{\mathrm H}\), local state \(h\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm H}\), and population welfare \(W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\) satisfying the following maintained conditions: \(W_{\mathrm H}\) is twice continuously differentiable in \(\gamma\) on a relative neighborhood of its optimizer graph; for every \(h\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm H}\), \(\operatorname*{argmax}_{\gamma\in\Gamma_{\mathrm H}}W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\) is a singleton in \(\operatorname{relint}(\Gamma_{\mathrm H})\); and \(-\nabla_{\gamma}^2W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\succeq c_{\mathrm H}I_{s_{\mathrm H}}\) on that neighborhood for one \(c_{\mathrm H}>0\). At \(\omega_0\), the finite-menu choice correspondence at \(h=0\) is \(\operatorname*{argmax}_{j\in[3]}h_j=[3]\), with \(h_3=0\), and every relative neighborhood of \(0\) in \(\mathcal H=[-1,1]^2\) contains states at which each labeled policy is uniquely welfare maximizing. If an instance of \(\mathfrak C_{\mathrm H}\) preserved the three labeled choices through an injective map \(\iota_{\mathrm H}:[3]\to\Gamma_{\mathrm H}\), in the explicit sense that \(\operatorname*{argmax}_{\gamma\in\Gamma_{\mathrm H}}W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)=\{\iota_{\mathrm H}(j):j\in\operatorname*{argmax}_{k\in[3]}h_k\}\) for every \(h\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm H}\), then at \(h=0\) its optimizer set would contain the three distinct points \(\iota_{\mathrm H}(1),\iota_{\mathrm H}(2),\iota_{\mathrm H}(3)\), directly contradicting the maintained singleton condition. Thus the rational witness is outside \(\mathfrak C_{\mathrm H}\) because its three-way tie fails uniqueness. Moreover, with \(K=4\), \(L=3\), and \(d=2\), the selectively observed model has \(2K(L-1)-d=14\) contrast-preserving nuisance coordinates, and projecting them by \(\Pi_r\) yields the design-dependent non-diagonal efficient covariance \(\Sigma(r)\). Higbee's smooth unique-optimum comparator therefore covers neither the witness's finite-menu tie geometry nor its selective-annotation nuisance step.
body.justification: The theorem isolates both obstructions to importing smooth unique-optimum policy-design theory: a genuine three-way local tie and an observation-design-dependent nuisance projection.
body.gap: Higbee (2026) derives two-wave policy design under a unique, strongly concave smooth policy optimum; the finite-menu tie geometry and selective-annotation nuisance experiment in this theorem lie outside those assumptions.
body.consumer: The result tells the attainment proof exactly which smooth argmax and direct-policy-observation reductions are unavailable at the rational witness.
